text: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It is 330 metres tall including its broadcast antenna and was the tallest structure in the world until 1930.
title: Eiffel Tower overview

text: Construction of the Eiffel Tower began in January 1887 and the tower was officially opened on 31 March 1889 for the Exposition Universelle.
title: Eiffel Tower construction

text: The Shard is a 72-storey skyscraper in London that reaches a height of 309.6 metres, making it the tallest building in the United Kingdom.
title: The Shard

text: Marie Curie was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903, shared with Pierre Curie and Henri Becquerel, and the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1911.
title: Marie Curie

text: Python is a high-level programming language created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991. It is maintained by the Python Software Foundation.
title: Python language

text: The capital of Germany is Berlin, which has been the seat of government since 1990. Berlin is located in the northeast of the country.
title: Berlin
